Algorithm: Shell sort
Shellsort: choose descending positive gaps ending in 1. For each gap h, insertion-sort each interleaved subsequence i, i+h, i+2h, and so on. One option is to generate 1, 4, 13, 40, … with h=3h+1, then use the suitable values in reverse. The final gap-1 pass produces ordinary sorted order.
provenance: Original concise procedure; Princeton University, Robert Sedgewick and Kevin Wayne, Algorithms 4th edition companion, 21elementary; https://algs4.cs.princeton.edu/21elementary/ . Algorithm paraphrase, not copied code.
